MAHANADI COALFIELDS ₹8,981 CRORE IPO OPENS

The public issue of Mahanadi Coalfields opened on 19 November 2026 and will close on 23 November, with listing expected on 27 November. The anchor book raised ₹2,295.2 crore, with LIC taking over 26% of that allocation.

The IPO comprises 66.18 crore equity shares offered entirely by existing shareholders, meaning the company receives no proceeds. Investors receive shares while the selling shareholders benefit from the capital raised.

For information only. Not investment advice.
